html:
Unique Research · Insight / Awards · November 18, 2022

4th Unique Awards (非凡奖 since 2019): ~200 cases from 100+ brands/vendors; first go-global track = 41.3% of submissions; ~1/3 product / 2/3 service cases. Scoring to jury next; ceremony early December. Jury pool: 100 across enterprise / brand / investor / academia / media committees.

This third guest batch: Zhao Xulong · Liu Yang · Huang Feng · Ding Feng · Lin Chen · Li Jingyuan · Yang Gang · Wang Xiaosai · Wang Jieming · Zhou Mi · Han Tao · Sun Liang · Du Xiaozhou · Chen Li · Shen Dongliang · You Tianyu · Dr. Jia Lijun · Dr. Deng Guangtao · Lin Guanchao · Chen Tejun — spanning listed internet/marketing firms, brand CMOs, MarTech founders, investors, and research leaders. Full bilingual titles, career notes, and headshots in the Chinese source gallery — attach on ingest.

— END —
